text: 上海市委财经工作委员会今天上午举行会议。会议听取了上海市落实构建房地产发展新模式相关工作汇报并指出，要坚决贯彻党中央决策部署，把让人民宜居安居放在首位，结合超大城市实际，不折不扣抓好基础性制度和长效机制的深化研究和落地落实，加快建立高品质供给、高效率保障、高水平运行的房地产发展新模式。着眼长远发展，高质量推进城市更新，健全住房供应体系，大力实施“房屋品质提升工程”，持续深化“规储供用”一体化机制，推动房地产高质量发展。
text_en: The Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting this morning. The meeting heard a report on Shanghai's work to implement the building of a new model for real estate development and noted that it is necessary to resolutely implement the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee, put making the people live comfortably and securely in first place, and, in light of the realities of a megacity, carry out to the letter the deepened research and implementation of foundational systems and long-term mechanisms, and accelerate the establishment of a new real estate development model featuring high-quality supply, efficient safeguards and high-level operation. With a view to long-term development, it is necessary to advance urban renewal with high quality, improve the housing supply system, vigorously implement the "Housing Quality Improvement Project," continue to deepen the integrated mechanism of "planning, reservation, supply and use," and promote high-quality real estate development.
